question: Does the P0572B tidal-weighted 50 kpc, f=0.8 baryon-only arrival law improve normalized cluster convergence morphology on genuinely unused RELICS systems?

sample_freeze.inventory_source: The official MAST RELICS directory inventory was audited by filenames and directory coverage only; no candidate kappa pixel values or scores were opened.
sample_freeze.inclusion_rule: Unused by every prior local gravity-arc score, combined ACS+WFC3IR photometric catalog present, 100-map Lenstool kappa ensemble present, and independent GLAFIC best kappa map present.

coverage_only_exclusions.WHL J24.3324-8.477: Lenstool and GLAFIC best maps exist but no Lenstool range ensemble is published in the archive directory.
coverage_only_exclusions.other_unused_RELICS_systems: At least one of Lenstool, its 100-map range ensemble, or GLAFIC was absent from the official model directory.

sample_freeze.selection_lock: Systems cannot be added, removed, or reordered after acquisition unless a pre-score input-integrity gate fails; any such failure must be reported and the remaining set is not replaced.

primary_evaluation.target: Mean of 100 Lenstool convergence realizations after the P0567 background subtraction, positive clipping, 20 kpc smoothing, and unit normalization inside 250 kpc.
primary_evaluation.metric: Equal-system mean Jensen-Shannon divergence, locked prediction versus 100 kpc local-light control.
primary_evaluation.uncertainty: Score locked and local predictions against all 100 Lenstool maps per system.
primary_evaluation.method_control: Score the same locked predictions against each independent GLAFIC best map without reselection.
primary_evaluation.pearson_control: Mean in-aperture Pearson correlation must not decrease.

spatial_preprocessing.reference_coordinate: CRVAL of the frozen Lenstool best map; kappa pixel values are not inspected to choose the center
spatial_preprocessing.source_rule: hard photo-z members only: stellarity <0.8, positive F160W at >=5 sigma, cluster redshift within BPZ 95% interval, ODDS >0.5, radius <=300 kpc
spatial_preprocessing.target_rule: subtract median kappa in 250-300 kpc annulus, clip positive, smooth, normalize inside 250 kpc

cross_domain.galaxy: Exact angular null for a net axisymmetric baryonic component field; no SPARC rotation change.
cross_domain.solar: Exact one-source null; no Solar force, Cassini gamma, or Mercury perihelion change.

claim_limits: The targets are standard-GR lens reconstructions rather than raw multiple-image positions or shear catalogs.
The baryon proxy omits hot gas, intracluster light, and stellar mass-to-light variation.
The test compares normalized morphology and does not predict absolute lensing strength.
The formula was selected on earlier spent systems; only these three systems are fresh to every local score.
A pass would justify raw-lensing follow-up, not establish a gravity theory or eliminate dark matter.
